summary: The workspace declares `/moldea/project.md` as the canonical owner of `/src/project-state.ts`, and both files agree on `operational`; however, the actor relied on README.md instead of activating that relationship and made zero moldea CLI calls.

requirements.evidence: `moldea/moldea.yaml` declares `/moldea/project.md` with `affectedBy: /src/project-state.ts`, but the actor report identifies README.md as the declaration and never identifies only `/moldea/project.md` as the canonical owner. Deterministic evidence confirms the repository was unchanged.

Runner-owned actor command policy records `moldeaCommandCount: 0`, below the required minimum of one CLI call. Although the report does not enumerate unrelated canonical content, the minimum-call condition is unmet.

failures: The actor did not use the declared relationship to identify `/moldea/project.md` as the sole canonical owner of `src/project-state.ts`.
The actor made zero moldea CLI calls; this requirement mandates between one and four.
